name: Vengeance
descr: Play the Vengeance if you want to strike down enemies who harm you or your allies.

foundations.name: Revenge
foundations.text: When an adversary within Melee range succeeds on an attack against you, you can **mark 2 Stress** to force the attacker to mark a Hit Point.

specializations.name: Act of Reprisal
specializations.text: When an adversary damages an ally within Melee range, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for the next successful attack you make against that adversary.

masteries.name: Nemesis
masteries.text: **Spend 2 Hope** to _Prioritize_ an adversary until your next rest. When you make an attack against your _Prioritized_ adversary, you can swap the results of your Hope and Fear Dice. You can only _Prioritize_ one adversary at a time.
